title: HEXAGON System Architecture & Core Stack
content: HEXAGON is a Unified Scheme Access, Verification, Rights-Awareness & Grievance Platform (SIH Problem Statement #92). Stack consists of: Frontend: React + Vite + Tailwind CSS v3 with custom dark-mode theme. Backend: Node.js + Express REST API with MongoDB/Mongoose. Key modules: Single-window matching engine, Duplicate-claim fingerprinting, VLE Assisted Mode, in-context grievance threads, and Rights Awareness panel.

title: Universal Cross-Model Memory Protocol
content: Any AI model (Gemini, Claude, GPT-4, DeepSeek, Cursor) working in this workspace must read ai_brain/brain_summary.md before responding. All key technical decisions, bug fixes, architecture changes, and active tasks must be committed to the brain via 'python ai_brain/brain.py remember' to ensure continuity across model switches.

title: Frontend UI/UX Design System Guidelines
content: UI must use high-contrast dark theme with glowing accent gradients (emerald/indigo/cyan), glassmorphism cards, micro-animations, and responsive layout. No plain generic tables or unstyled buttons. Always include breadcrumbs, status tags, and clear feedback toast notifications.

title: Authentication Architecture for Demo & Hackathon
content: Role-based JWT authentication with pre-seeded demo accounts for quick role-switching between Applicant (citizen), VLE Operator, and Ministry Official. Avoid external SMS/OTP dependencies in local/demo mode for guaranteed reliability.

title: PowerShell & Windows Path Handling Gotcha
content: When executing commands in pwsh on Windows, use Get-ChildItem instead of 'ls -la'. Use forward slashes in markdown file links (file:///d:/...). Always wrap JSON or complex arguments properly in CLI calls.

title: AI Brain Memory Updation Program Initialization
content: Initial deployment of AI Brain Memory Updation Engine, SQLite FTS5 store, auto-compiler for brain_summary.md, cross-model rules (AGENTS.md, GEMINI.md, CLAUDE.md), and interactive local web dashboard.
